::: {.callout-note}
This report reads participant-level demographic and clinical records that are
not publicly shared, so it cannot be re-rendered from this repository. Only
aggregate results are shown. The model covariates (age, sex, race, and PTSD
status) are included in the shared feature data.
:::

## Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

### Data

```{r}
# Restricted REDCap exports (not shared)
redcap_dir <- Sys.getenv("CMBA_REDCAP_DIR", r"(Z:\CMBA_PTSD\1_RAWDATA\redCAP)")

redcap_vars <- c(
  "record_id", "race", "ethnicity", "sex", "age", "income", "education",
  "phq_total", "pcl5_m_total", "caps_mnth_total", "caps_mnth_ptsd",
  "suds_account", "suds_impact"
)

read_redcap <- function(file, group) {
  read_csv(
    file.path(redcap_dir, file),
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
  ) |>
    select(all_of(redcap_vars)) |>
    summarize(
      .by = record_id,
      group = group,
      across(everything(), \(x) first(x, na_rm = TRUE))
    )
}

demo_all <-
  bind_rows(
    read_redcap("CMBA-Patients_2022-12-05_1438.csv", "patient"),
    read_redcap("CMBA-Control_2023-03-10_1522.csv", "control")
  ) |>
  # participants who completed the behavioral tasks
  filter(!is.na(suds_account)) |>
  transmute(
    record_id,
    GRP = factor(group),
    Race = factor(
      as.numeric(race),
      levels = 1:7,
      labels = c(
        "American Indian",
        "Asian",
        "Black",
        "Hispanic",
        "More than one race",
        "White",
        "Unknown"
      )
    ),
    Ethnicity = factor(
      as.numeric(ethnicity),
      levels = 1:3,
      labels = c(
        "Not Hispanic or Latino",
        "Hispanic or Latino",
        "Unknown"
      )
    ),
    Sex = factor(
      as.numeric(sex),
      levels = 1:6,
      labels = c(
        "Male",
        "Female",
        "Intersex",
        "Transgender (sex assigned at birth female, now male)",
        "Transgender (sex assigned at birth male, now female)",
        "Prefer not to say"
      )
    ),
    Income = factor(
      as.numeric(income),
      levels = 1:7,
      labels = c(
        "< $10,000",
        "$10,000-19,999",
        "$20,000-39,999",
        "$40,000-79,999",
        "$80,000-169,999",
        "$170,000+",
        "Prefer not to say"
      )
    ),
    Age = as.numeric(age),
    Education = as.numeric(education),
    PHQ9 = parse_number(phq_total),
    PCL5 = parse_number(pcl5_m_total),
    CAPS5 = parse_number(caps_mnth_total),
    PTSD = factor(caps_mnth_ptsd, levels = 1:0, labels = c("PTSD", "Control")),
    SUDS_Account = parse_number(suds_account),
    SUDS_Impact = parse_number(suds_impact)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Race = if_else(
      condition = Race == "Hispanic" & Ethnicity == "Hispanic or Latino",
      true = "White",
      false = Race
    ),
    across(Race:Sex, \(x) fct_na_value_to_level(x, "Unknown"))
  )

n_group <- table(demo_all$PTSD)
n_group
table(Recruitment = demo_all$GRP, Diagnosis = demo_all$PTSD)
```

## Group Comparisons

### Categorical Variables

```{r}
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if_else(p < .001, "p < .001", paste("p =", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p))))
}

tabulate_var <- function(data, var) {
  tab <- table(droplevels(data[[var]]), data$PTSD)
  pct <- 100 * prop.table(tab, 2)
  tibble(
    variable = var,
    level = rownames(tab),
    n_ptsd = tab[, "PTSD"],
    pct_ptsd = pct[, "PTSD"],
    n_ctrl = tab[, "Control"],
    pct_ctrl = pct[, "Control"]
  )
}

# Sex: chi-square test
sex_test <- chisq.test(table(droplevels(demo_all$Sex), demo_all$PTSD), correct = FALSE)

# Race and ethnicity: Fisher's exact test because some expected counts are < 5
race_test <- fisher.test(table(droplevels(demo_all$Race), demo_all$PTSD))
ethnicity_test <- fisher.test(table(droplevels(demo_all$Ethnicity), demo_all$PTSD))

# Income: Fisher's exact test, excluding "Prefer not to say"
income_data <- filter(demo_all, Income != "Prefer not to say")
income_test <- fisher.test(table(droplevels(income_data$Income), income_data$PTSD))

categorical_tests <- tibble(
  variable = c("Sex", "Race", "Ethnicity", "Income"),
  test = c(
    sprintf("χ²(%d) = %.2f, %s", sex_test$parameter, sex_test$statistic, fmt_p(sex_test$p.value)),
    paste("Fisher's exact,", fmt_p(race_test$p.value)),
    paste("Fisher's exact,", fmt_p(ethnicity_test$p.value)),
    paste("Fisher's exact,", fmt_p(income_test$p.value))
  )
)

categorical_table <-
  map(categorical_tests$variable, \(v) tabulate_var(demo_all, v)) |>
  list_rbind()

categorical_tests
```

### Continuous Variables

```{r}
continuous_vars <- c(
  "Age" = "Age (years)",
  "Education" = "Education (years)",
  "SUDS_Account" = "SUDS, Account",
  "SUDS_Impact" = "SUDS, Impact",
  "PCL5" = "PCL-5",
  "CAPS5" = "CAPS-5"
)

# Mann-Whitney U tests with rank-biserial correlations (positive = higher in PTSD group)
continuous_table <-
  imap(continuous_vars, \(label, var) {
    x <- na.omit(demo_all[[var]][demo_all$PTSD == "PTSD"])
    y <- na.omit(demo_all[[var]][demo_all$PTSD == "Control"])
    w <- wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)
    tibble(
      variable = label,
      m_ptsd = mean(x), sd_ptsd = sd(x),
      m_ctrl = mean(y), sd_ctrl = sd(y),
      U = unname(w$statistic),
      p = w$p.value,
      r = unname(2 * w$statistic / (length(x) * length(y)) - 1)
    )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

continuous_table |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(m_ptsd:sd_ctrl, r), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt_number(columns = U, decimals = 1) |>
  fmt(columns = p, fns = \(p) sub("p = ", "", fmt_p(p)) |> sub(pattern = "p ", replacement = "")) |>
  cols_label(
    variable = "", m_ptsd = "M (PTSD)", sd_ptsd = "SD (PTSD)",
    m_ctrl = "M (Control)", sd_ctrl = "SD (Control)"
  )
```

## Table 1

```{r}
table_1 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(row = "Categorical variables", c1 = "Count", c2 = "Percent", c3 = "Count", c4 = "Percent", test = "", type = "header"),
  map(categorical_tests$variable, \(v) {
    bind_rows(
      tibble(row = v, test = categorical_tests$test[categorical_tests$variable == v], type = "variable"),
      categorical_table |>
        filter(variable == v) |>
        transmute(
          row = level,
          c1 = as.character(n_ptsd),
          c2 = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_ptsd),
          c3 = as.character(n_ctrl),
          c4 = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_ctrl),
          test = "",
          type = "level"
        )
    )
  }) |> list_rbind(),
  tibble(row = "Continuous variables", c1 = "M", c2 = "SD", c3 = "M", c4 = "SD", test = "r", type = "header"),
  continuous_table |>
    transmute(
      row = variable,
      c1 = sprintf("%.2f", m_ptsd),
      c2 = sprintf("%.2f", sd_ptsd),
      c3 = sprintf("%.2f", m_ctrl),
      c4 = sprintf("%.2f", sd_ctrl),
      test = sub("-", "−", sprintf("%.2f", r)),
      type = "level"
    )
) |>
  mutate(across(c1:c4, \(x) replace_na(x, "")))

table_1 |>
  gt() |>
  cols_hide(type) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 1",
    subtitle = "Demographic and Clinical Characteristics by Group"
  ) |>
  tab_spanner(label = sprintf("PTSD (n = %d)", n_group[["PTSD"]]), columns = c(c1, c2)) |>
  tab_spanner(label = sprintf("Control (n = %d)", n_group[["Control"]]), columns = c(c3, c4)) |>
  cols_label(row = "", c1 = "", c2 = "", c3 = "", c4 = "", test = "Group Comparison") |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(c1:c4, test)) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(rows = type == "header")) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(indent = px(12)), locations = cells_body(columns = row, rows = type == "variable")) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(indent = px(28)), locations = cells_body(columns = row, rows = type == "level")) |>
  tab_source_note(md(paste(
    sprintf(
      "*Note.* The control group includes %d controls and %d patients who did not meet criteria for PTSD.",
      sum(demo_all$GRP == "control" & demo_all$PTSD == "Control"),
      sum(demo_all$GRP == "patient" & demo_all$PTSD == "Control")
    ),
    "Categorical variables: percentages are column percentages within each group.",
    "Sex was compared with a chi-square test. Race, ethnicity, and income were compared with",
    "Fisher's exact test because some expected cell counts were below 5; the income test excluded",
    sprintf("\"Prefer not to say\" responses (remaining n = %d).", nrow(income_data)),
    "Continuous variables: groups were compared with Mann-Whitney U tests; *r* is the rank-biserial",
    "correlation, with positive values indicating higher values in the PTSD group.",
    if (all(continuous_table$p < .001)) "All comparisons of continuous variables were significant at *p* < .001." else "",
    "SUDS: Subjective Units of Distress Scale, rated for the trauma account and impact tasks;",
    "PCL-5: PTSD Checklist for DSM-5; CAPS-5: Clinician-Administered PTSD Scale for DSM-5 total severity."
  )))
```
